pages.title: Demonic Migration North
pages.text: This page follows demonic_six_sects.json. The six sects are centered on tiannan_north_waste, represented in the current world data by the demonic Tiannan Wasteland entrance tag. For now, this entry indexes their sects, methods, and karmic routes.

pages.title: The Six Branches
pages.text: The Ghost Spirit Sect practices soul seizure, corpse refinement, and yin fire; the Harmonious Joy Sect favors charm arts, paired cultivation, and deception; the Heavenly Demon Sect cultivates demonic bodies, frenzy, and blood sacrifice; the Azure Net Sect specializes in poison and insect puppets; the Myriad Fox Sect uses illusions and fox demons; and the Blood Shaman Cult wields blood curses and shamanic arts.

pages.title: Method Requirements
pages.text: The source corpus lists root methods such as the Profound Yin Art, Ghost Spirit Soul-Seizing Art, Harmonious Joy Heart Art, Heavenly Demon Body-Tempering Art, Azure Net Poison Art, Myriad Fox Illusion Art, and Blood Shaman Curse. This guide currently describes their lore relationships; sect admission, method drops, orthodox bounties, and branch skill trees are not yet fully integrated.

pages.title: Karmic Risks
pages.text: Demonic routes are designed around demonic_karma and may trigger denial of entry or hostility from orthodox powers such as Yellow Maple Valley and Tianlan Temple. The full demonic reputation and exclusion system is not yet implemented; future gates must reuse server-side reputation, quest, and method-learning checks rather than trusting client choices.
